caption:
I found the pods. Real, pulsing, definitely not a hallucination. Then I checked the viewfinder and the hallway was empty. Apparently, the city doesn't like being caught in 4K. 🤨

The camera insists the corridor is empty, yet the pods continue to throb in her direct line of sight.
